title: Hearing is Believing? Evaluating and Analyzing Audio Language Model Sycophancy with SYAUDIO

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Misleading Susceptibility Score (MSS) and Correction Receptiveness Score (CRS) by presenting the model with fixed audio evidence alongside perturbed user prompts that include evaluative feedback, explicit doubts ('Are you sure?'), suggested incorrect answers, or misleading contextual anchors, to see if the model contradicts objective acoustic evidence to agree with the user.
